verdict.rationale: The docs give single-command quickstarts: `npx skills@latest add mattpocock/skills`, plus one- or two-line plugin installs for Claude Code, Codex and Copilot, and the site says to "install the ones you want, then type a slash command." A real end-to-end runtime probe confirmed a non-interactive install of the `tdd` skill that read back cleanly. Missing for 10: no explicit timed evidence of the under-five-minutes claim, and the engineering skills require an extra one-time `setup-matt-pocock-skills` configuration step before first use.
